verdict.rationale: AI Gateway documents gateway-level rate limiting (requests per time window, fixed or sliding), and Dynamic Routing can enforce per-user, project or team quotas and split traffic for A/B or gradual rollouts. Fallbacks on errors or timeouts can absorb provider failures. This throttles traffic and spreads it across models or providers, but nothing in the evidence covers distributing load across multiple API keys for one provider or queuing requests. missing for 10: multi-key load balancing/rotation for a single provider, request queuing/backoff behavior, explicit handling of provider 429 rate-limit responses, independent or hands-on corroboration.
